subject: Re: Mesh Diffusion kickoff — pilot results + decisions
body:
Team,

Pilot wrapped 06-08. Results and decisions:

1) Artist ratings: 4 of 5 production meshes rated "usable with minor touch-up" or better; average time-to-variation dropped from ~2 days to 40 minutes. That's the win we pitched.
2) Decision: the robust remesher is officially the Q3 follow-on, funded — Maren scopes it with the asset team. Until then, the tool ships internally with the pre-screening checklist and the documented ~1-in-5 manual-prep caveat.
3) Decision: per-mesh-family FLDM training is accepted as the model for now; Oyin's tooling queues family training jobs overnight so artists don't feel it.
4) Scope cut: text-conditioned texture prompts — much requested — explicitly out until the research side matures.

This closes our window as a success. Writing it up for portfolio review Thursday.

Priya
